title: Polynomial-time first-bit XOR output
statement: For a bit string $s$, parse its two components using the aligned pair parser, taking both components to be empty if parsing fails. The function that returns the one-bit word given by the exclusive OR of the first bits of the two components when both components are nonempty, and returns the empty word otherwise, is polynomial-time computable.
